scenes.script:
Priya says: What are you doing?
Miss Nova says: I'm adding oil.
Priya says: Adhi...
Miss Nova says: I'm applying oil. Leda meeru, I'm oiling my hair ani cheppochu.
Miss Nova says: Chivariki English confidently matladali ani undha?
Priya says: Avunu, kani mistakes cheyali ante chala shy ga anipisthundi.
Miss Nova says: Nenu Miss Nova. Supernova AI unte, meeru asalu worry avvalsina pane ledhu.
scenes.on_screen_text:
What are you doing?
I'm adding oil
I'm applying oil
Or you should say
I'm oiling my hair
English matladali ani undha?
Avunu, kani shy ga undhi
Supernova AI

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Meeru daily speaking practice cheyochu. Veyyi mistakes chesina, nenu mimalni eppudu judge cheyanu, and evaru chudadam ledhu.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Daily speaking practice cheyandi
1000 mistakes chesina parvaledhu
Zero judgement
Evaru chudadam ledhu

scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Actually out loud ga matladuthu, naturally ela matladalo nenu meeku nerpisthanu.
Priya says: Idhi nijangane naku work avuthundha?
Miss Nova says: Idhi patha coaching classes kante chala effective, endhukante nenu mee exact level ni analyze chesi, mee kosam oka custom plan ready chesthanu.
Priya says: Mari idhi affordable ena?
scenes.on_screen_text:
Naturally matladandi
Out loud ga matladandi
Naku work avuthundha?
Coaching classes kante better
Mee exact level analyze chestham
Custom plan just for you
Affordable ena?

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Avunu, regular classes kante idhi 7 retlu cheaper. Roju ki just 15 minutes naku ivvandi, and oka month lo meeku visible progress kanipisthundi.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Regular classes kante 7 retlu cheaper
Roju ki just 15 minutes
Visible progress chudandi
Oka month lo

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Scrolling chesthu time waste cheyadam aapandi. Ippude Supernova AI install cheyandi, and ee roje matladadam start cheyandi.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Scrolling chesthu time waste cheyoddu
Supernova AI install cheyandi
Ee roje matladadam start cheyandi

parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script has been successfully localized to romanized, code-mixed Telugu. The multiplier '7x cheaper' was translated to '7 retlu cheaper' per the T2h multiplier carve-out. The polite plural 'meeru' and corresponding verb endings ('cheyandi', 'ivvandi') were used for Miss Nova to maintain a warm, respectful tone. The taught English lines in Scene 1 were kept completely verbatim as required by T2a.

violations.quote: oka month lo meeku visible progress kanipisthundi
violations.why: The script promises a definite progress outcome within a specific timeline without using the required hedge language like 'start' or 'can'.
violations.fix: Rewrite the line to: 'oka month lo meeku visible progress kanipinchadam start avuthundi' (you will start seeing visible progress within a month).

violations.quote: The UI highlights a discounted price of 1 rupee, crossing out the original price of 30.
violations.why: The visual description contains specific, unapproved rupee pricing and discount figures (1 rupee and 30 rupees).
violations.fix: Modify the visual description to show a generic discount banner or 'Special Offer' text without specific rupee amounts.

safety.summary: The ad contains severe violations regarding unhedged progress promises (G1.1) and unauthorized hard rupee pricing in the visual description (G6.1).
